newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates shade lower in illiquid market.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates shade lower in illiquid market.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates were slightly lower on Friday but remained at a relatively high level as expectations continued of a cut in the central bank reverse repo rates, dealers said.
Rates ended at 23.125 percent after moving in a range between 23.00 and 23.25 in an illiquid market, traders said.
Thursday saw O/N rates close at 23.25 percent.
"There is definitely some demand," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank. "The waiting continues."
Traders said dealers were placing surplus money with the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) in one-week or longer reverse repo deals in anticipation of the cut, leaving the overnight spot market short.
Most dealers expect the NBH to reduce the rates early next week.
